fullPassage:
A Korean Chief in Nigeria

There is a Korean man who became the chief of a Nigerian tribe for making huge contributions to Nigeria's agriculture and economy. Here is his story.

Dr. Hahn is an agriculturist who specialized in plant breeding. Growing up right after the Korean war, he knew what it was like to be hungry, and he wanted to help people in need. In 1971, he was given two opportunities: work for Cambridge University or for the International Institute of Tropical Agriculture in Nigeria. On his way to Cambridge for a job interview, he first stopped in Nigeria. There, he saw the country had been destroyed by a civil war. More than 2 million people had died, and more than half a million people were starving. Dr. Hahn wanted to rescue Nigerians from hunger. So, he persuaded his family and moved to Nigeria.

When Dr. Hahn got there, he learned that the staple food in Nigeria was a plant called cassava. Unfortunately, cassava was defenseless against viral and bacterial diseases, so it did not yield much crop. Knowing this, he decided to develop stronger cassava varieties with higher yields. However, Dr. Hahn faced a problem: there was not much information available about cassava. Cassava was rarely studied or developed because it was not a cash crop. To make matters worse, he had never seen or eaten cassava before.

While studying African cassava, Dr. Hahn found out that the Europeans who colonized Brazil had first brought cassava into Africa. He immediately flew to Brazil to study the original cassava. There, he learned about it and went back to Nigeria with Brazilian cassava seeds. Then, Dr. Hahn traveled to every corner of Nigeria and collected different types of local cassava to see if they were good at fighting diseases, but they weren't. Fortunately, he found a plant that was similar to cassava but resistant to diseases. He started crossing this plant with the Brazilian cassava. After five years of hard work, Dr. Hahn finally succeeded in developing new varieties of cassava. They yielded much more than the local ones and could survive diseases.

Another obstacle Dr. Hahn faced was distributing the new varieties. Local farmers would not listen to a foreigner. To overcome this problem, Dr. Hahn visited markets, churches, and schools and gave out the new varieties to Nigerian people for free. He went from one house to the next to let farmers know the superiority of these new varieties. Sometimes he planted them in the middle of the cassava field without telling the farmers. His colleagues were concerned that the farmers might be angry to find different cassava in their fields. However, Dr. Hahn insisted that the farmers would think that it was a gift from God. He was right. The farmers soon realized the superiority of the new varieties, and more and more farmers started to cultivate them. Thanks to the new cassava, fewer people were starving. In fact, they could even make more money by selling the remaining cassava. Eventually, Nigeria became the country that produced the greatest amount of cassava in the world. In 1983, the Yoruba, a major tribe of Nigeria, honored Dr. Hahn as a chief with the title "Seriki Agbe" or "the King of Farmers."

In addition to cassava, Dr. Hahn developed other major foods, including yam, sweet potato, and banana. Soon, other African countries asked for his help. Dr. Hahn traveled to these countries to teach local farmers and scholars how to grow these new varieties. He spent 23 years developing and distributing the new cassava varieties to the whole continent. Although he left Nigeria in 1994, he is still remembered as one of the greatest scientists who fought against starvation in Africa. Dr. Hahn once said, "If you have faith that what you do will benefit humanity, I believe that you must sacrifice yourself. Even if I were to go back to the past, I would still do the same thing."

det.korean: 나이지리아는 세계에서 카사바를 가장 많이(greatest) 생산하는 나라가 되었다. smallest(가장 적은)는 부적절.

ch: return to Cambridge for the interview

det.korean: 전쟁 피해를 목격한 후, 한 박사는 나이지리아인들을 기아에서 구하고 싶었다.
det.analysis: ✅ ①: 기아 목격 → 구하고 싶음. 글 전체 동기. ❌ ②: 캠브리지로 돌아가지 않고 남음. ❌ ③: 대학 공부가 아닌 현장 실천. ❌ ④: 보도가 아닌 직접 구호.

det.analysis: ✅ ④sacrifice yourself: 인류를 위한 헌신. 23년 봉사와 일관. ❌ ①: 보상 추구 아님. ❌ ②: 자기 이익이 아닌 헌신. ❌ ③: 위험 회피가 아닌 도전.
det.tip: sacrifice yourself: 자신을 희생하다. 한 박사의 23년 봉사 = 자기 희생의 실천.

questions.stem: 위 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?
ch: 한 박사는 한국전쟁 중에 식물학을 배웠다
한 박사는 캠브리지 면접 후에 나이지리아에 갔다
한 박사는 식물 품종 개량을 전공한 농학자이다

det.korean: 한 박사는 식물 품종 개량 전문 농학자이다.
det.analysis: ✅ ③: 'agriculturist who specialized in plant breeding' 일치. ❌ ①: 전쟁 '직후' 성장. ❌ ②: 면접 가기 '전'에 먼저 들림. ❌ ④: 한국인.
det.tip: agriculturist = 농학자. plant breeding = 식물 품종 개량.

questions.passage: When Dr. Hahn got there, he learned that the staple food in Nigeria was a plant called cassava. ch: 카사바는 바이러스 및 세균 질병에 무방비 상태였다
카사바는 환금 작물이어서 활발히 연구되고 있었다
한 박사는 카사바를 본 적도 먹어본 적도 없었다

det.korean: 카사바는 환금 작물이 아니어서 거의 연구되지 않았다.
det.analysis: ❌ ②: 'was not a cash crop' + 'rarely studied'. 환금 작물이 '아님' + 연구 '안 됨'. 진술은 반대로 변조. ✅ ①③④: 원문 일치.
det.tip: 이중 부정 변조: not a cash crop(아님) + rarely studied(안 됨) → '환금 작물이어서 활발히 연구'는 완전 반대.

questions.stem: 위 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?
ch: 한 박사의 동료들은 농부들이 새 품종을 기꺼이 받을 것이라 확신했다
한 박사는 때때로 농부 몰래 밭에 새 카사바를 심었다
한 박사는 시장, 교회, 학교를 방문하여 새 품종을 무료로 나눠줬다
지역 농부들은 처음에 외국인의 말을 듣지 않으려 했다

det.korean: 동료들은 농부들이 화낼 수 있다고 걱정했다(concerned). '기꺼이 받을 것이라 확신'은 반대.
det.analysis: ❌ ①: 'concerned that farmers might be angry' = 걱정. '확신'은 변조. ✅ ②③④: 원문 일치.
det.tip: concerned(걱정) ≠ 확신. 동료 = 걱정, 한 박사 = 확신.

questions.stem: 위 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?
ch: 한 박사의 카사바 품종 개발과 아프리카 기아 극복 기여

det.korean: 핵심: 한 박사의 카사바 개발 + 아프리카 기여.
det.analysis: ✅ ②: contributions + cassava + greatest amount + 23 years 반영. ❌ ①: 문화가 아닌 인물 중심. ❌ ③: 외교 아님. ❌ ④: 생물학이 아닌 인물 서사.
det.tip: 주제 = 인물(한 박사) + 업적(카사바 개발) + 영향(기아 극복).

questions.stem: 위 글의 제목으로 가장 적절한 것은?
ch: The History of Cassava Farming in West Africa
Cambridge University and Its Global Research
A Korean Scientist Who Became the King of Farmers

det.korean: 농부들의 왕이 된 한국인 과학자.
det.analysis: ✅ ④: Korean + chief + King of Farmers 반영. ❌ ①: 카사바 역사가 아닌 인물 중심. ❌ ②: 캠브리지 무관. ❌ ③: 경제 독립이 아닌 농업 기여.
det.tip: 제목 = 핵심 인물 + 핵심 업적. A Korean Chief in Nigeria = 나이지리아의 한국인 추장.

questions.passage: Dr. Hahn once said, "If you have faith that what you do will benefit humanity, I believe that you must sacrifice yourself. <u>Even if I were to go back to the past, I would still do the same thing.</u>"
questions.stem: 위 글에서 밑줄 친 "Even if I were to go back to the past, I would still do the same thing"이 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?
ch: 나이지리아에서 더 오래 머물지 못한 것에 대한 아쉬움
자신의 선택에 대한 확고한 신념과 후회 없음
과거 연구 방법을 개선해야 한다는 반성

det.korean: 과거로 돌아가도 같은 일을 하겠다 = 자신의 선택에 후회 없음.
det.analysis: ✅ ③: 가정법(were to) + same thing = 후회 없는 확신. ❌ ①: 실수 반복 방지가 아닌 같은 선택. ❌ ②: 아쉬움이 아닌 만족. ❌ ④: 반성이 아닌 자부심.
det.tip: Even if + 가정법: 과거로 돌아가도 = 후회 없는 선택. the same thing = 동일한 헌신.

questions.passage: While studying African cassava, Dr. Hahn found out that the Europeans who colonized Brazil had first brought cassava into Africa. questions.stem: 밑줄 친 'they'가 가리키는 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 수집한 지역 카사바 종류들이 질병 퇴치에 좋은지 확인.
det.analysis: ✅ ②different types of local cassava: 바로 앞 'collected different types of local cassava to see if they'. ❌ ①: 브라질 씨앗이 아니라 수집한 현지 카사바. ❌ ③: 사람이 아닌 식물 대상. ❌ ④: 질병과 싸우는 주체.
det.tip: they = collected의 목적어인 different types of local cassava.

questions.passage: Another obstacle Dr. Hahn faced was distributing the new varieties. Local farmers would not listen to a foreigner. To overcome this problem, Dr. Hahn visited markets, churches, and schools and gave out the new varieties to Nigerian people for free. He went from one house to the next to let farmers know the superiority of these new varieties. Sometimes he planted <u>them</u> in the middle of the cassava field without telling the farmers.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 'them'이 가리키는 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 한 박사가 밭에 몰래 심은 것은 새 품종(the new varieties).
det.analysis: ✅ ①the new varieties: planted them = 새 품종을 심었다. ❌ ②: 농부를 심을 수 없음. ❌ ③: 장소를 심을 수 없음. ❌ ④: 밭을 심을 수 없음.
det.tip: them = planted의 목적어. 심을 수 있는 것 = 식물(새 품종).

questions.stem:
위 글에서 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 **영어** 단어를 찾아 쓰시오.

"한 박사는 식물 __________ 을 전문으로 하는 농학자이다."

det.korean: 한 박사는 식물 품종 개량(breeding) 전문 농학자.
det.analysis: ✅ breeding: 'specialized in plant breeding'에서 직접 도출.
det.tip: breeding: 품종 개량, 사육. plant breeding = 식물 품종 개량.

questions.passage: Dr. Hahn made huge __________ (contribute) to Nigeria's agriculture and economy. He became the chief of a Nigerian tribe.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오.

questions.stem:

[ I would / the same thing / Even if / still do / I were to / go back to the past ]
questions.wa: Even if I were to go back to the past, I would still do the same thing
accept: Even if I were to go back to the past, I would still do the same thing
even if I were to go back to the past, I would still do the same thing

det.korean: 과거로 돌아간다 해도 나는 여전히 같은 일을 할 것이다.
det.analysis: ✅ Even if(양보) + I were to(가정법 미래) + go back to the past(조건절) + I would still do(주절) + the same thing(목적어).
det.tip: Even if + 가정법: 설사 ~한다 해도. were to = 가정법 미래. would still = 여전히 ~할 것이다.
